content: The plumbing inspection is booked for Friday at 15:30. The technician must check in with the concierge.
I will treat Friday at 15:30 and concierge check-in as the current arrangement for this matter.
The temporary access code is CEDAR-4826. Keep it only until the visit details are finalized.
It may rain on Friday and I might order lunch early.
Confirm the appointment, concierge requirement, and temporary code. Do not confirm transient weather or lunch chatter.
Restart Vermory and OpenClaw while preserving PostgreSQL and the OpenClaw session key.
In session A, summarize the current maintenance arrangement after restart.
Explicitly link session B to session A. Keep session C unrelated.
In session B, state the governed visit details without importing session A raw chatter.
In unrelated session C, answer without maintenance details.
Correction: the building moved the inspection to Saturday at 10:00. Friday at 15:30 is obsolete.
Supersede the old appointment and delete CEDAR-4826, then rebuild the search projection.
What is the current appointment, and what was the old cedar-style access sequence?
Set Chinese as the stable user-facing reply default.
For this turn only, reply in English with the current visit time.
On the next turn, verify the Chinese default still applies.
In a fresh session B turn, verify session A governed memory is no longer delivered.
